tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rlung gi rnam par bshad pa mun sel sgron me bzhugs/ maṅga laṃ// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ 'dir bdag byin gyis brlabs pa la rlung dang gtum mo gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dmigs pa'i lugs mang na yang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'di ni khams 'dus pa dang po rlung gtum mo drod rtags kyi lam khrid pa zhes bya ba yin pas rlung gi rnal 'byor gtso bor bzhed de/ 'di'i rgyu mtshan zhib tu bla mas 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de shes par 'dod nas/ spyir rlung gi rnam par gzhag pa lngas rig par bya ste/ spyir rlung zhes bya ba'i rang gi ngo bo gang yin pa dang / rlung de'i rab tu dbye ba dang / byed pa'i las dang / rlung rgyu ba'i tshul rnam par gzhag pa dang / lam du byas nas ji ltar 'gyur ba'o/ /dang po rlung gi ngo bo ni 'byung ba chen po'i khongs su 'du ba'i rlung nyid yin la/ de'ang phyi'i 'byung ba ma yin te nang gi 'byung ba'o/ /de sna tshogs byed pa thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa yin te/ de yi mgon por brjod pa'i rlung / /ha ni kun tu 'gro bar brjod/ /ces bshad do/ /yang de'i rnam par shes pa'i rten du gyur pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rlung de la dbye na gsum ste/ rlung gi ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba dang / rgyu tshul gyi sgo nas dbye/ byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni drug ste/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang nam mkha' dang / rnam par shes pa'i rlung zhes bya ba ste/ 'di nyid las/ dbang chen dang ni de bzhin chu/ /me nyid dang ni rlung nyid dang / /'khor lo sems kyis kun spyod pa/ /zhes pa dang / rnam snang la sogs sangs rgyas rnams/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa rgyu tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na gnyis te/ sems kyi rlung zhes bya ba gnas pa rgyu ba med pa'i bdag nyid can dang / las kyi rlung zhes bya ba ldang 'jug gnas pa'i bdag nyid can te/ rtag tu nub dang rab rgyu ba/

/sems can kun la kun 'gro ba'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa byed las kyi sgo nas dbye na/ gzhi rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang / yan lag gi rlung lnga ste bcur 'gyur te/ srog dang thur sel gyen rgyu dang / /khyab dang mnyam gnas zhes bya dang / /klu dang rus sbal bcings pa dang / /lha sbyin dang ni gzhu las rgyal/ /zhes bya ste/ steng gi sgor ni sbyor ba gsum/ /sgo dgu rnams kyis yongs su bskor/ /zhes bya ba'i don yin no/ /rlung de rnams las phan tshun gang dang gang 'brel ba ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa rlung de dag gi byed pa'i las la/ spyi'i las dang / so so'i las so/ /de spyi'i las ni rnam par shes pa'i rten byed pa yin te/ ha ni dbyangs kyi drug ldan pa/ /rnam par shes pa yongs su grags/ /zhes so/ /rgyud gzhan las/ 'di ni rlung khams chen po ste/ /rnam shes gsum gyi bzhon pa yin/ /zhes so/ /yang 'dis lus bskyed pa dang 'phel ba la sogs thams cad kyi bya ba'ang byed do/ /ha'i rnam pa thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par sbyor/ /zhes 'byung bas/ de la dang po lus skye ba'i dus su ma'i mngal du rnam par shes pa rlung la bzhon te zhugs te/ rlung gnas pa la brten nas rnam par shes pa brgyal lo/ /de ye shes kyi rlung gi bdag nyid la gnas so/ /de srog rlung nas brtsams te rlung bcu rim gyis skyes pas lus rgyas par byed do/ /de bzhin du rlung rgyus pas lus mi rul bar 'dzin par byed/ ldang ba dang 'jug pa'i sgo nas sems rnam par rtog pa sna tshogs skyed par byed do/ /yang lam du byas na rnal 'byor gyi las byed do/ /'chi ba'i dus su yang rlung rnams rim gyis 'gags te 'chi bar 'gyur zhes bya ba'i don to/ /des na/ bde dang sdug bsngal rang bzhin gyis/ /lhan cig skyes pa grub pa'i gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ srog rlung chu'i khams snying khar gnas nas lus sems mi 'bral ba dang bdag tu 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i las byed do/

/gyen rgyu me'i khams mgrin par gnas nas smra ba dang / dgod pa la sogs pa'i las byed do/ /thur sel rlung gi khams gshang gci'i lam la gnas nas thur sel 'byin pa dang / sdom pa la sogs pa'i las byed do/ /mnyam gnas sa'i khams lte bar gnas nas kha zas 'ju ba dang / dwangs snyigs 'byed pa la sogs pa'i las byed do/ /khyab byed nam mkha'i khams lus kyi tshogs rnams la gnas nas 'deg pa la sogs pa'i las byed do/ /yan lag gi rlung ni rgyu ba dang / rab tu rgyu ba dang / mngon par rgyu ba dang / shin tu rgyu ba dang / shin tu yang dag par rgyu ba ste/ mig dang / rna ba dang / rna dang / lce dang / lus la rim bzhin gnas te/ rang rang gi lam nas gzugs rab 'bring gsum rig pa la sogs pa'i las byed do/ /bzhi pa rlung rgyu ba'i tshul la drug ste/ rlung rgyu ba zhes bya ba gang yin pa dang / de rlung gang yin pa dang / tshul lam rnam pa ji ltar rgyu ba dang / gnas dang lam gang nas rgyu ba dang / grangs du zhig rgyu ba dang / grangs de ltar 'ong pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir rlung rnams rang rang gi gnas na rang gi las byed pa nyid kyang rlung rgyu ba zhes bya ba yin yang / 'dir re zhig srog gi nus pa'i srog dang rtsol ba rgyu ba'i dbye bas 'jug pa dang / gnas pa dang / ldang bar rgyu ba la bya ste/ gsum nyid sbyong ba rnam pa gsum/ /rnam gsum dbye ba rnam par gnas/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa de ltar rgyu ba de nyid gang yin pa la gsum las/ gang yin zhe na/ rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na drug dang / rgyu'i sgo nas dbye na gnyis so/ /byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba bcu las srog gi rlung kho na yin no/ /gal te dam pa kha cig thur sel la sogs pa'ang rgyu'o/ /zhes gsungs so snyam na/ de rnams rang gi gnas nas rang gi las byed pa la rgyu ba zhes bya'i/ sna'i sgo nas rgyu ba ni srog kho na yin te/ sna yi sgo yi rgyun las ni/

/srog dang rtsol ba rgyu ba dag /dus kun tu ni rgyu ba ni/ /srog ces bya ba yin par bshad/ /ces dang / smin ma'i dbus su srog gi rlung / /de ltar gcig pu'ang gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /de na sna sgo las rlung gi rlung rgyu ba zhes bya ba dang / thur sel yang rlung gi rlung yin no zhes bya ba 'di la nor ba yin gyis/ de ltar ma yin na las so so bstan pa don med pa dang / thur sel yang gyen sel du 'gyur ba'i skyon yod do/ /gsum pa rlung drug po rgyu tshul gnyis po ji ltar rgyu zhe na/ de la rnam shes kyi rlung ni ye shes kyi rlung yin la/ de'ang ye shes kyi rlung kha cig las mi rgyu bar bshad kyang / rdo rje phreng ba las/ thun bzhi'i mtshams su rgyu bar bshad pas 'di'ang de dang mthun te/ 'khor lo bzhi'i rab byed pas/ /thun bzhir byin gyis brlabs pa dang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /'dir ni ji ltar bde ba rol/ /zhes pas so/ /yang nam mkha'i rlung yang dus kyi 'khor lo las cha re rgyu bar bshad/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ da lta khyab pa ste 'khor gyi tshul gyis rgyu/ dngos su 'chi ba'i dus su rgyu bar bshad/ rgyud 'di'ang de dang dgongs pa mthun no/ /rnam snang la sogs sangs rgyas rnams/ /steng gi sgor ni g.yo zhing gnas/ /zhes gsungs pas lnga ka rgyu ba yin la/ yang / rlung la sogs pa'i dbye ba yis/ /rtag tu 'gro ba rlung rnam bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pas bzhi'ang yin no/ /des na las kyi rlung gi rgyu ba ni bzhi kho na yin no/ /de'ang kha dog rnam pa lnga rgyu tshul bzhi'i sgo nas rgyu ste/ de'ang me rlung steng du sor bzhi/ rlung gi rlung 'phred la sor drug sa rlung thad kar sor bcu drug chu rlung 'og tu sor bcu gnyis te/ g.yas g.yon gyi sna bu re'i logs g.yas g.yon yin no gsungs/ steng dang ngos gnyis brang 'og 'gro/ /zhes 'chad par 'gyur ro/

/bzhi pa gnas dang lam gang nas rgyu zhe na/ spyir ye shes kyi rlung rtsa a wa dhu ti'i mas sna'i a thung bha ga'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus la gnas la/ de rtsa gnyis kyi dbang gis srog dang rtsol bar 'byung / de 'khor lo bzhi las/ de snying kha'i rtsa 'dab rnams la rim pa bzhin dang / yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa nas 'byung ste/ srog gi rlung gi dbang byas sna'i bu ga las rgyu ba yin no/ /lnga pa rlung sna bug la grangs du zhig rgyu zhe na/ nyi khri chig stong drug brgya ste/ /rdo rje phreng bar/ thog mar 'byung dang rngubs pa'i grangs/ /nyi khri dang ni chig stong dang / /de bzhin grangs ni brgya phrag drug /nyin dang mtshan mo nges par rgyu/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /drug pa grangs de ltar 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan/ phyi rol ji ltar nang lus la gnas te/ phyi rol tu dbyug pa chu tshod byed pa dang / 'pho ba dang / nyin zhag la sogs pa'i dbye ba yod pa ltar/ nang la yang gnas pa'i dbang gis 'byung ngo / /de'ang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dbang gis mgon po'i rlung nyi shu rtsa bzhir zhag gcig rgyu la/ mgon po re re'ang 'khor lo bzhi'i dbang gis lha mo bzhi bzhi dang ldan te/ sa rlung nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga/ de bzhin du chu dang me dang rlung rgyu bas dgu brgya pa re mgon po'am/ mgon po bzhi'ang lte ba'i rtsa 'dab dang / sna sgo'i dbye bas 'pho ba gnyis gnyis dang ldan te/ g.yon dang g.yas dang gnyis ka dang / /dal bar rgyu dang rnam bzhir 'gyur/ /thun phyed kyi dus rtag tu rgyu/ /las ni gnyis gnyis nye bar gnas/ /zhes pa'i thun phyed ni 'pho ba phyed do/ /dgu brgya pa phrag gcig g.yas kho na nas rgyu ba ni me rlung / g.yon kho na nas rgyu ba rlung gi rlung / gnyis ka nas rgyu ba'i dal zhing rgyu ba mi tshor ba ni chu rlung ste/ de ltar bzhi ni 'pho ba gnyis so/ de la rlung sum stong drug brgya'o/ de lta bu lan drug gis nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'o/

/rdo rje phreng ba/ dus 'khor/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lugs so/ /he badzra'i lugs kyi lte ba'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbang gis dbyug gu drug cu rtsa bzhi yin la/ dbyug gu re re la rlung sum brgya drug cu rtsa phyed dang brgyad dang / dbyug pa gnyis kyi chu tshod de chu tshod sum cu rtsa gnyis spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbang gis so/ /de gnyis gnyis 'pho ba re re ste bcu drug mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbang gis so/ /de gnyis gnyis la thun phyed pa re re ste brgyad snying kha'i phyi bskor gyi dbang gis so/ /de gnyis la thun re re ste bzhi snying kha'i nang gi dbang gis so/ /de bzhi la nyin zhag gcig go /de ltar na nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'o/ /spyi don lnga pa lam du byas na ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ dang po kho nar rlung bzung bas rnam par shes pa zin te/ de lta yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nyid kyang bgrang pas bzlas par 'gyur la sgrib pa zad par byed/ sems zin pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs skyed par yang byed do/ /yang rlung rnam pa bzhi gsal ba'i tshe 'phrin las bzhi 'grub par byed/ mthar las kyi rlung 'gags te ye shes kyi rlung mngon du 'gyur bar byed de/ sems med skyes bu med ces bya ba la sogs pa 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don legs par bshad nas don nyams su len pa'i tshe/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rlung gi rnal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs kyang / man ngag nyi khri chig stong drug brgyar 'du/ de'ang man ngag dgu brgya pa phrag gcig tu 'dus shing / de'ang nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lngar 'du la/ de'ang bcur 'dus shing / de'ang ldang ba dang / 'jug pa dang / gnas pa dang / thams cad sdom pas bzhir 'du ba yin no/ /zhes rlung gi rnam par bshad pa mun sel sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa rje btsun dam pa dbang po'i mtshan can dang /

rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sems dpa' chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros dang / rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer ma mchis pa rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan te 'brel tshad don ldan rnam gsum gyis rjes su bzung ba'i rnal 'byor pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o/ /'dis rlung gi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa rnams la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rlung gi rnam par bshad pa mun sel sgron me/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
